sentence: This project studies how differences in genes and in gene regulation shape the two alternative calls made by a katydid species.
This project tests whether the cytoskeleton and the proteins that anchor it to the outside act as sensors of gravity in cells.
This project builds sensing systems that learn what task the data is for and adjust how they collect, rebuild and use the data.
This project builds low-cost tests that detect endotoxins from bacteria without needing horseshoe crab blood.
This project applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to engineering problems in imaging, biomedical systems and smart infrastructure.
This project gets a low-voltage electron microscope to image materials and marine sponges at very small scales.
This project studies how software developers learn to see the security threats their software may face.
This project studies the theory behind hypergraph learning, including how much data it needs and what model designs it requires.
This project studies how much quantum information can be sent over a physical communication link.
This project applies graph data analytics and machine learning to problems in social networks, bioinformatics and business.
This project studies how mechanical forces in the bone marrow help red blood cell precursors push out their nucleus.
This project builds computer tools that use machine learning to find viruses and study their roles in nature.
This project brings together industry professionals and researchers to find out how to teach cybersecurity and artificial intelligence in middle school.
This project studies how the size and flow of rivers affect the amount of greenhouse gas they release.
This project builds methods to judge whether autonomous systems that use learning are safe, with both yes-or-no answers and numerical measures.
This project studies how people's social strategies and technologies related to changes in their environment over a long time.
This project studies how bacteria on leaves make compounds that scavenge iron and how these compounds affect plants and insects that feed on them.
This project builds algorithms that find where text comments on the meaning of a word and that retrieve specific uses of an ambiguous word.
